title: Dragon Fire Anagama Firing – October 2026
source_quote:
October 2026
Loading October 2 & 3
Firing October 4-9
Unloading October 17
SIGN UP FOR SHIFTS beginning Monday, August 24 at 6 pm HERE
evidence_sentence: The wood-fired anagama kiln firing runs October 4-9, with participants earning kiln space by working shifts.
evidence_quote: This Japanese-style cave kiln is fueled by wood and holds hundreds of pots.
summary: A community wood-firing of the Dragon Fire Anagama kiln October 4–9, 2026. Earn kiln space by working shifts: loading, stoking, wood-cutting, and kiln-site work days. Points earned from work hours determine loading priority; points may also be purchased at $25 each. Bring bisque-fired Cone 10 pieces; participants glaze and wad their own work.
commitment: Fri-Sat load · Sun-Fri stoking shifts · Oct 18 unload
bring: Bisque-fired Cone 10 pottery, work gloves, protective clothing
cost_text: $25 per point (optional purchase for kiln space)
how_to_join: Sign up for shifts beginning August 24 at 6 pm on the platform at https://go.artcenterky.org/signup, or contact the Art Center at 859-236-4054
